title: Truly no one is doing it like James Acaster and if you don’t already ...
transcript: I just got back from seeing James Acaster in New York. James is one of my absolute favorite comedians. Obviously fell in love with him on taskmaster and then I found his stand up specials on Netflix and I've always wanted to see him live. I kept missing his past couple New York shows cause I kept finding out about them after they had already sold out. But I finally got a chance to see him and let me tell you, it was worth the wait. And of course, in classic James Acaster fashion, this is not a straightforward comedy set. There's always gonna be some kind of twist or angle, and in this case he is doing the entire set as a James Acaster impersonator named Craig Simons. It is incredibly meta with a lot of callbacks to classic James Acaster bits. So I think long time James Acaster fans are gonna get the most out of this. He makes several references to this throughout the show, but this does feel a lot like his earlier work, specifically repertoire on Netflix, where he does the whole set as a cop undercover as a stand up comedian, and he builds out all of this lore for this fake police officer that he's playing. Very similar thing here with Craig Simons. I really don't want to give too much away about the set because it is full of a lot of fun surprises, but it really shows that James is acutely aware of How he is perceived by fans and critics and he has used that to create a really compelling hour of comedy. I really hope this one gets filmed and ends up on a streaming service somewhere because it has the potential to be an all time Acaster set.
classificationReason: Review of James Acaster's live stand-up comedy show in New York. Not a Broadway/West End stage production on the provided list.
